name: In-Core Volume Rendering
aliases: In-core volume rendering for Cartesian grid fluid dynamics simulations
definition: Srend is a volume rendering code designed for visualization of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) simulations using Cartesian grids. It is designed to be compiled within the application for in-core rendering, eliminating the need for external visualization tools or post-processing steps.
summary: In-Core Volume Rendering embeds direct volume ray casting within CFD simulations to produce immediate imagery without external post-processing, differing from established renderers by using a user-defined rendering tree instead of supervisory load balancing.
